_about: Scope of every page of the Google guide snapshot (source/) for reviewing Flare topics. core: rules sent with every review. pack: rules sent when the section contains that kind of content (trigger). lint: mostly enforced by the linter, with judgment rules going to the AI. reference: not review rules; kept for updates or covered by the pages they summarize. Every unit of a core/pack/lint page must be covered by a rule card or marked not-applicable with a reason in the compiled layer; the coverage report fails otherwise.

about.why: How the guide works and which sources win; no writing rules.

highlights.why: Summary; each item links to the page that holds the rule.

whats-new.why: Change log: drives updates of this layer, not reviews.

philosophy.why: Why the guide exists; no writing rules.

word-list.why: Term-by-term usage: deterministic rows where possible, judgment entries to the AI by trigger word.

text-formatting.why: Summary table of formatting rules on other pages.

other-sources.why: #63: applies to any text, not only sections with links (uncited copying has no link)
